g.title: The golden path: from a feature branch to a registered model
g.text: The golden path: from a feature branch to a registered model
Trunk-based · test your change on your own branch · main makes the official run · what an ML engineer does, and what happens

g.title: cluster_legend_frame
g.text: Once per project: create it in Backstage. You get a repository from ml-project-template, an ECR repository, a namespace and GPU queues
git checkout -b feat/…, change the code, git push. Every push to a feature branch starts your own test run
CI builds the image feat-<branch>-<sha> and pushes it to ECR
CI submits the workflow over Tailscale: dev queue (low priority), sample data, a smaller GPU budget
Karpenter starts a GPU node; the run logs to MLflow, experiment …/dev. You compare runs in MLflow; CI comments the numbers on the PR
Review, then squash-merge to main. CI builds main-<sha>: immutable, kept
The official run: main queue, full data → MLflow experiment …/main → a registered model version
The feature branch is deleted: its images go now; its runs expire later (second picture)
